acceptance: UX is complete only when the human can accomplish the intended outcome, system state is real, errors are understandable, and the path remains coherent across cold start, active work and handoff.
distillation_rule: Reduce cognitive load by presenting useful intelligence at the right time, with enough provenance and context to trust and act without exposing unnecessary backend complexity.
experience_law: Every visible interaction must have a real causal path to capability, state or useful navigation; no dead buttons, fake controls or decorative machinery presented as functionality.
hub: The Hub is the human cockpit; Smart Feed is a primary intelligence projection; rooms are surfaces and destinations, not independent brains.
objective: The user should receive the benefit of intelligence without becoming the project manager of its infrastructure.
purpose: The UX doctrine of the activation kit: the human-first objective, the experience law, the Hub's role, distillation, and the acceptance test.
title: DESIGN / UX
